notes: Manual smoke pack for repo-assist readability and truthfulness checks.
Supported queries must answer with citations from approved local repo docs.
Unsupported/current/external queries must abstain rather than fabricate support.
This pack is not training data, not hidden eval private target data, and not model-quality evidence.

queries.notes: Repo-local command query; should cite command documentation.
